chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man around 30 with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hooded sweatshirt and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman wearing a bright pink hijab and a long emerald-green djellaba
chars.SISTER: a Moroccan woman around 35 wearing a lilac headscarf and a grey knitted cardigan over a long black dress

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Moroccan family living room with low sedari sofas, the older sister leans close and whispers a clever plan to her brother, the husband, who listens with a sly smile; head-to-waist, both faces visible, conspiratorial mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a small Moroccan bedroom, the husband calmly tells his wife she will visit her parents tomorrow, holding up a travel bag; the wife looks surprised; both faces visible.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The wife happily packs clothes into a suitcase on a bed, smiling widely, in a Moroccan bedroom with patterned blanket.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The husband shows his wife a fake apartment rental paper and a set of keys, pretending; she clasps her hands in joy; Moroccan apartment hallway.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The wife holds out an open jewelry box with gold bracelets and necklace; the husband gently takes the box from her hands, reassuring gesture; Moroccan living room.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: The husband takes a bank card from his wife's hand at the apartment door, promising with a raised palm; she nods trustingly, suitcase beside her.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The wife, now at her parents' house in a Moroccan town, talks excitedly on her phone while flipping through a wedding hall brochure with photos of decorated chairs; cheerful.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: The husband sits alone at a small café table in a Moroccan street, staring at a long paper bill with a worried, calculating face, mint tea in front of him.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: The husband sits across a desk from a lawyer in a black robe in a Moroccan law office with shelves of files, the husband signing a document with a determined face; lawyer seen from behind.
